verdicts.reason: A squeezes the quote onto one tiny line that is barely readable, while the attribution 'AIKO TANABE, ARCHITECT' is rendered much larger and bolder, so the hierarchy is inverted. The quote mark has shrunk to a speck and the oversized logo block dominates. B wraps the quote onto two more legible lines, but the attribution is still bigger and heavier than the quote and sits jammed right under it with no gap. B also has the same tiny quote mark and logo-heavy bottom half, so it is the less bad of two broken layouts.
